Blixo specializes in subscription billing and accounts receivable automation within the financial technology sector. The company provides services such as automated invoicing, subscription management, collections, and cash application processes that assist businesses in managing financial transactions.
Blixo's solutions include tools for buy now, pay later options, automated payment reminders, and customizable customer portals. It was founded in 2020 and is based in Santa Monica, California.
